title.label: Been looking for this app for decades.

content.label:
I'm dictating this review into Wispr Flow, and I'm just going to let the results fall where they may.

I'm a 75-year-old retired software engineer. I can remember when Dragon Dictate first came out. I tried it. Never could get it to be accurate enough to be really useful. 

Wispr Flow seems to me the best application for AI that I've yet seen. At first, I didn't like the fact that it didn't display the text as I talked, but I now see that as an advantage because, for a perfectionist like me, the temptation to edit and fix is overwhelming. It slows things down to the point where I don't say or get around to writing all of the things that I intend to.

So I'm giving it five stars based on only a limited amount of experience. I may go back and change that. But for now, I'm pretty happy.
